judgments.rationale: In draft claim C0001, 'object' was improperly set to 'Subparagraph (A)' (which is the grammatical subject of the statutory rule stating it shall not apply), and 'action' was erroneously extracted from within the conditional clause ('if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice...'). Proposal P0000 remedies this defect by clearing these misattributed fields, accurately reflecting that C0001 functions as a qualification/exemption governing C0000 while preserving the correct actor, modality, logic condition, and target relationship.

Proposal P0001 changes the actor of the exemption to 'Commission'. Under clause (i) (F006), the exemption applies to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State upon the attorney general's determination. The Commission does not appear in F006 and is not the actor exempted by this provision.

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.

(B) Exemption

(i) In general

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.
